digest.component_or_area: LLM provider resolution and OpenAI adapter
propositions: Hosted OpenAI (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt with no custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default under pydantic-ai 1.107.2
Custom endpoint configurations (top-level base_url, per-class slot endpoint, per-candidate endpoint, gateway/openai, vendor alternatives) must remain on openai-chat: as a fallback
An explicit openai-chat: qualifier or provider declaration must emit a once-per-run deprecation notice pointing to openai-responses: with pre-v1 removal target v1.0.0
Capability resolution for openai-responses: must maintain feature parity (native_structured_output) with openai-chat:
Contract tests covering structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, and custom base URLs must pass for both openai-responses: and openai-chat: paths
